title: Wood and Glass
text:
Wood is a natural material. It is hard, but it feels warm to touch. Many tables and chairs are made of wood. Some wood has a smooth surface, and some has a rough surface.

Glass is different. It is smooth and cold. You can see through glass, so windows are often made of glass. Glass can break easily, so you must be careful.

questions.text: What are many tables and chairs made of?
Why are windows often made of glass?
Why would someone prefer wood for a chair?
What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Wood and glass are two materials with different features
Wood is always better than glass
Glass is only used for windows
Stone is the best material for furniture

vocabulary.definition: a substance used to make things
paying attention in order to avoid harm or damage

paragraph_translations: Деревина — це природний матеріал. Вона тверда, але на дотик здається теплою. Багато столів і стільців зроблені з деревини. Деяка деревина має гладку поверхню, а деяка — шорстку.
Скло — інше. Воно гладке і холодне. Крізь скло можна бачити, тому вікна часто роблять зі скла. Скло може легко розбитися, тому треба бути обережним.
